Finding submitted.

**Deviation — MINCOMMIT (Section 5(a), with conforming edit to Section 6).**

- **What we found:** Section 5(a) sets an unconditional monthly floor ("but not less than $____ per month for the Hosting Services and $____ per month for Support Services") payable regardless of usage, recurring through each automatic one-year renewal (Section 13). Section 6 compounds it by excluding those minimums from Client's documentation and dispute rights.
- **Why it fails fallback:** no right to reduce the commitment on 30 days' notice (only whole-agreement termination under Section 14, effective as late as the last day of the month following notice) and no true-up for underused volume.
- **Cure (preferred level, two surgical replacements):** delete the fee floor so fees are payable only for requested Hosting and Support Services and state that Client has no minimum purchase or volume commitment; conform Section 6 by removing the now-dangling "minimum monthly fees" carve-outs. Fallback (12-month-limited, reducible, trued-up floor) offered in the comment.
- **Not flagged:** Section 3(i) credit-report ordering is usage-triggered sourcing, not a volume commitment; the storage/bandwidth figures are service specifications.
